description: Canonical career identity and domain taxonomy. Skill weights and market metrics are intentionally excluded at this stage.

design_notes.canonicalization: One canonical career name per role; aliases are matching aids only.
design_notes.domains: One primary domain plus optional secondary domains.
design_notes.career_level: Seniority is modeled separately rather than duplicated as separate careers.
design_notes.external_mapping: Verified ESCO/O*NET identifiers can be attached in a later enrichment step.
